lead.h: Workbenches add a "heart rate" widget. Makers: we can only help you if we know you
p: After this week's update a heart-rate widget appeared in the top right corner of several workbenches. The makers say the data comes from "the rhythm of your use". Users asked how the data is obtained. The makers said: "the rhythm of your use".
One user says her heart rate and the page's loading spinner keep the same time.
